create.name: Monterey Bay Zen Center
create.bio:
Monterey Bay Zen Center is a Soto Zen sangha on California's central coast, practising in the line of Shunryu Suzuki without a temple building of its own. It began in Carmel in 1988, when Sobun Katherine Thanas, then teaching at Tassajara, agreed to lead a weekly sitting; she remained its teacher until her death in 2012, latterly also serving as abbot of Santa Cruz Zen Center. Today a teaching council of four Dharma teachers, with Shogen Danielson and Robert Reese as guiding teachers, shares the work with two ordained practice leaders.

The community sits in two borrowed spaces: an arts gallery in Carmel that becomes a zendo on Tuesday evenings, and a small zendo in McGowan House beside St James Church in Monterey. The week holds morning zazen on Mondays and Thursdays, a noon sitting on Wednesdays, an informal Friday lunchtime group and the main Tuesday evening of zazen, service and a Dharma talk, with some sessions also open on Zoom. Free meditation instruction is given early each month, monthly half-day zazenkai offer a short retreat, and the sangha holds classes, sesshin and lay ordination. Practice is free, supported by donations and membership.

courses.title: Zazenkai 2026 — Monthly Sittings
courses.description: A monthly half-day sitting at the McGowan House zendo with zazen, walking meditation, a short talk, a closing service and sometimes light work practice, suited to beginners and experienced sitters alike. The November sitting is led by practice leader Guy Riina; attendees are asked to stay for the whole schedule.

courses.title: Weekly Groups & Meditation Offerings
courses.description: The regular week of practice: Monday and Thursday morning zazen with chanting, Wednesday noon sitting with a reading and discussion, Friday's Brown Bag Zen and Tuesday evening zazen, service and Dharma talk, with practice discussion available with the teachers. Some sessions are also open on Zoom.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Contributing membership, paid monthly or yearly, that keeps the sangha's two practice places, its teachers, sesshin and scholarships going, renewing a programme first set up by the founding teacher.

free_resources.title: Zazen Instruction
free_resources.description: An outline of how zazen and walking meditation are practised in the sangha, what to expect at the first-Tuesday instruction in Carmel, and links to further video and printed guidance on posture.

free_resources.title: Online Sutra Book (chants)
free_resources.description: The texts chanted at morning zazen, including the Heart Sutra, the Metta Sutta and short daily verses, with a downloadable PDF chant book for home practice.
